actual_author_derivation: Own stdlib source transformation executed once to derive external fixtures and metadata. It does not import or execute app/parser/tests/proposed project modules, Git, CI, browser or network.
input_revision_membership: Parent-frozen revision relationships inherited; physical SHA256/Git-blob hashes freshly checked. No Git membership command performed.
private_policy: PRIVATE_DO_NOT_COMMIT contains original source segments and normalized bodies, notes and quotations. Only public metadata/hash artifacts and producer are eligible for later parent-selected metadata publication.
output_provenance: Expected hashes derive from exact raw publisher source and originalXML/current canonical metadata, not from a runtime/parser/API output. The author derivation is not its own independent approval.
